requirements.requirement: The system must retrieve triage result objects from the chat response payload and pass them into the MessageBubble component for rendering.
The system must render triage explanations within the same MessageBubble instance as the associated clinical trial response.
The system must preserve message ordering such that triage-enhanced responses appear in the correct chronological sequence in ChatWindow.
The system must ensure triage content is rendered before any quality metrics within the MessageBubble.
The system must support rendering multiple trial triage results within a single chat response without UI overlap or truncation.
The system must correctly bind each triage result to its corresponding trial identifier in the UI.
The system must display triage pass/fail indicators as provided by the triage data without transformation errors.
The system must render human-readable explanation text from triage data without loss or truncation of content.
The system must not render triage UI elements when no triage data is present in the response payload.
The system must gracefully fallback to standard MessageBubble rendering when triage data is missing or null.
The system must handle malformed triage data structures by suppressing triage rendering and logging an error without breaking the chat UI.
The system must maintain consistent formatting between triage-enabled and non-triage MessageBubble components.
The system must ensure that triage rendering does not introduce additional latency exceeding acceptable chat response thresholds.
The system must support incremental rendering such that triage data appears when available without blocking the full message display.
The system must ensure that triage data integration does not alter or overwrite existing non-trial chat content.
